title: Kick-off Meeting
description: Project coordinators, communication leads, and youth workers met in Germany to launch the Green Horizon partnership. The consortium aligned on work packages, established quality and risk monitoring protocols, and agreed on the training course curriculum.

photo.alt: Consortium partners during the opening session of the kick-off meeting in Germany
photo.caption: Kick-off meeting opening session in Germany (28–29 July 2025)

title: Training Course on Drone Operation, Photography and Video Editing
description: An intensive 8-day training course hosted by Asociația Empower Plus bringing together 18 youth workers from Germany, Romania, and Türkiye. Participants received hands-on training in camera drone flight safety, photographic framing, and video post-production to act as multipliers.

photo.alt: Youth workers practicing camera drone flight maneuvers during the training course in Brașov, Romania
photo.caption: Youth workers practicing drone flight skills in Brașov, Romania (11–18 October 2025)

photo.alt: Cover of the Green Horizon Educational Booklet
photo.caption: Official Educational Booklet published under CC BY-SA 4.0

title: Booklet on Drone Operation, Photography and Effective Ways to Mitigate Climate Change
description: A comprehensive Educational Booklet co-authored by the partnership covering climate change mitigation concepts, photography composition, and drone operation safety rules. Includes 6 practical flight drills and a printable field checklist.

title: Local Workshop
description: Organized by IESA, trained youth workers guided local youth in camera drone flight basics, environmental observation, and photographic composition. Participants documented local coastal and urban ecological topics.

photo.alt: Local youth workshop participants preparing camera equipment and flight checklists in Mersin, Türkiye
photo.caption: Local youth workshop in Mersin, Türkiye (19 April 2026)

title: Local Workshop
description: Hosted by Integrational e.V., local young people learned camera drone safety, flight controls, and visual storytelling methods to observe riverbank habitats and urban green spaces.

photo.alt: German youth participants with camera drones during local field workshop in Germany
photo.caption: Local youth workshop in Germany (23 April 2026)

title: Local Workshop
description: Organized by Asociația Empower Plus, young participants practiced camera drone piloting, video capture, and photo framing to document local environmental realities.

photo.alt: Romanian young people gathered around a screen reviewing drone photographs
photo.caption: Local youth workshop in Romania (29 April 2026)

title: Documentary Series Production & Exhibition Photo Selection
description: Young people worked in local production teams to film, edit, and finalize the documentary series and curate high-resolution drone photography for the dissemination conferences and exhibition.

photo.alt: Youth editing climate documentary footage on a laptop
photo.caption: Documentary editing and photo curation by youth participants (May–July 2026)

photo.alt: Welcome panel of the Green Horizon virtual exhibition
photo.caption: Virtual exhibition goes live online (October 2026)

title: VR Exhibition Online Launch
description: The digital version of the photo exhibitions presented at the conferences went live online in October 2026. It allows visitors worldwide to take a guided virtual tour of youth drone photography and explore climate change in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye from above.

title: Dissemination Conference
description: Asociația Empower Plus hosted the national dissemination event where youth-created documentary films and the Green Horizon photo exhibition were presented to local community members, educators, and stakeholders.

photo.alt: Dissemination conference in Romania showcasing youth climate documentaries and photo exhibition
photo.caption: Dissemination conference in Romania (17 July 2026)

title: Dissemination Conference
description: IESA organized the dissemination conference in Mersin, showcasing the project results, screening the documentary short films, and exhibiting photographs of local climate challenges to community stakeholders.

photo.alt: Screening of youth climate documentaries at the dissemination conference in Mersin, Türkiye
photo.caption: Dissemination conference in Mersin, Türkiye (22 July 2026)

title: Dissemination Conference
description: Integrational e.V. presented the final project results, screening the youth documentaries and displaying the photography collection to local youth leaders, educators, and community representatives.

photo.alt: Participants and stakeholders gathered at the dissemination conference in Germany
photo.caption: Dissemination conference in Germany (25 July 2026)

title: Final Partner Meeting
description: Representatives from Integrational e.V., Asociația Empower Plus, and IESA met in Mersin to evaluate all project results, review participant feedback, finalize reporting procedures, and plan future collaboration.

photo.alt: Consortium partners during the final transnational meeting in Mersin, Türkiye
photo.caption: Final partner meeting in Mersin, Türkiye (31 July – 1 August 2026)
